subject: general
question: In 2024, which company entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with iCreate to promote AI startups in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Microsoft**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2024, **Microsoft signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the International Centre for Entrepreneurship and Technology (iCreate) **to promote AI startups in India.
 
• This **collaboration, facilitated by the Ministry of Electronics & IT (MeitY), aims to support AI startups across both urban and rural areas of the country**.
 
• The** initiative includes the iMPEL-A**I (iCreate-Microsoft Programme for Emerging Leaders in Artificial Intelligence) program, which plans to screen 1,100 AI innovators nationwide, focusing on sectors such as healthcare, financial inclusion, sustainability, education, agriculture, and smart cities.
 
• The **top 25 startups will receive go-to-market support from Microsoft's global network.**
 
• Additionally, **the partnership intends to provide AI skilling opportunities to 11,000 innovators,** startups, and young Indians through Microsoft's Learning Management System, offering globally recognized certifications upon completion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Infosys**

 
 
• Infosys Limited **is an Indian multinational technology company that offers business consulting, information technology, and outsourcing services. **
 
• **Founded in 1981**, the company is headquartered in Bengaluru.
 
• On 24 August 2021, **Infosys became the fourth Indian company to achieve a market capitalization of US$100 billion**.
 
• As of 2024, Infosys is the second-largest Indian Big Tech company by revenue and market capitalization.
